title: Palisades (Holtec restart): OEDO-26-02609 2.206 Petition - Palisades Refueling Operations - Alan Blind - NRC Acknowledgment of Receipt (EPID L-2026-CRS-0005) [['2.206 Acknowledgment Letter', 'E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:              Dennis Galvin
To:                "Alan Blind"
Cc:                Petition Resource
Subject:           NRC Receipt of 10/4/2026 2.206 Submittal Regarding Palisades Refueling Operations
Date:              Monday, October 5, 2026 1:45:00 PM




Hello Mr. Blind,

The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) staff has received your 10 CFR 2.206
submittal regarding Palisades refueling operations, “Petition Pursuant to 10 CFR 2.206,”
dated October 4, 2026. The NRC is considering the request for immediate actions and is
performing an initial screening of the submittal to determine if the petition, or portions of the
petition, should be entered into the 2.206 process, consistent with Management Directive
8.11, “Review Process for 10 CFR 2.206 Petitions,” (NRC’s Agencywide Documents
Access and Management System Accession No. ML18296A043). You will be contacted, in
the near future, regarding your request for immediate actions and the NRC staff’s initial
screening determination. Please contact me if you have any questions regarding the 2.206
petition review process.

Note that because the 2.206 petition process is a public process, the petition and all the
information in it, including identity of the petitioner, will be made public at the end of the
screening process.

Thanks,

Dennis Galvin
Project Manager / Agency 2.206 Petition Coordinator
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Office of Nuclear Reactor Regulation
Division of Operating Reactor Licensing
Plant Licensing Branch II-2
301-415-6256
